verdict.rationale: GitBook documents version control, change-request review workflows, and Git sync that together let AI-agent-driven content edits (via GitBook Agent/change requests) be reviewed and reverted through underlying git history, which stands in for 'automations' in a docs context. However there is no dedicated automation/workflow engine, execution history, or explicit rollback UI for AI actions beyond standard git-based versioning. Missing for 10: a purpose-built automation run history/audit log, explicit one-click rollback of agent actions, and independent evidence this works reliably in practice.
